page.heroTitle: How ExpoPlatform has grown, quarter by quarter
page.heroLede: Everything we have delivered for organisers, exhibitors and attendees since January 2023, grouped by product theme. Select any feature to see what we built, why it was needed and how it helps.
page.nextLede: Work that is in development now. These features have no fixed dates yet, and their scope may change before release.
page.footNote: Covers features delivered from January 2023 to September 2026. Coming next items are in development and may change.

2023.label: Foundations
2023.title: New foundations for websites, floor plans and search
2023.review: The year started with passwordless login, interactive floor plans, exhibitor events and parent and child exhibitors. By mid-year organisers had a new analytics dashboard, full control over which modules each event uses, and QR and barcode scanning at check-in and kiosks. The second half brought the new website builder with dynamic content blocks, global search, email nurturing, custom lead capture questions, multi-factor login for admins, and native integrations with ExpoFP, Visit and Klipso.

2024.label: Networking
2024.title: New ways to network, and a new way to pay
2024.review: 2024 was the year of structured networking: speed networking arrived in the spring, followed by opt-in speed networking and round tables, while AI relevance sorting put the best matches first. Websites became multilingual and gained custom forms and pop-ups. Exhibitors got a redesigned account, attendees could rate sessions, and the year closed with a new basket and payment page, new ticketing, AI-powered exhibitor search and login codes by WhatsApp and SMS.

2025.label: Intelligence
2025.title: Smarter matching, AI meeting notes and hosted programmes
2025.review: Calendars began syncing automatically and matchmaking recommendations updated in real time. Custom pages became search-engine friendly, and attendees could manage their tickets from their profile. In the second half, AI meeting notes, Lead Capture Pro and hosted meeting programmes launched, with full programme management for organisers by the end of the year. Invoice payment and the first release of Public API v3 completed the year.

2026.label: So far
2026.title: A rebuilt registration, AI across the event, and an open API
2026.review: This year has brought custom page grids, offline floor plans, OCR badge scanning and automated event reporting dashboards. AI now writes personalised meeting notes, answers attendees' questions about the agenda and restyles website blocks. The rebuilt registration experience, a session calendar view, unified global search, a much larger Public API v3 and an integrations catalogue arrived in the third quarter.
